for the people of the parish 10.30 a.m. sr. esther i. 12 noon patrick o’kelly i. please submit items for the newsletter by 9 a.m. on tuesdays. “one in christ, united in mission” the theme for world mission sunday is chosen by the holy father.
this year, 2026, we are celebrating the centenary of this special day of prayer, solidarity and missionary awareness.
pope leo xvi is the first pontiff in modern history to have served most of his priestly ministry as a missionary before becoming a successor to st. peter.
when he served as a missionary priest and bishop of peru, he saw firsthand how the faith, prayer and generosity shown on world mission sunday can transform entire communities.
the annual collection is important because 1,130 diocese in mission territories cannot sustain themselves financially.
yet the day is fun- damentally spiritual before it is financial.
recent popes have repeatedly emphasised that mission begins with prayer, witness and communion.
every baptised person shares responsibility for proclaiming the gospel and supporting the growth of the church throughout the world.
prisoners’ sunday-11th october a prayer for people in prison god of seen and unseen struggles, christ in all things, we pray for all those in our prisons, whose mental health is a constant battle.
we lift up those who are visibly troubled, and those who struggle in the dark.
in moments of grief, may they know your compassion.
in times of depression, may they know your nearness.
when faced with addiction, surround them with your grace.
bless those who work to lighten their burdens, and may we be compelled to do likewise.
amen. monthly church gate collection takes place after all masses this weekend 10th/11th october.
thank you for your continued support for the essential work of st. vincent de paul.
